name: table-count
description: Number of Drizzle pgTable() definitions across shared/. The mature-machine north star is a SMALLER schema (<=450 tables); today's count is far above it. This strict down-only ratchet makes the schema monotonic: adding a table fails CI until the baseline is deliberately bumped (a conscious 'yes we need this'), and every consolidation lowers the baseline toward the target. Founder-chosen 'strict' 2026-07-16.
lastBumpNote: 752 -> 753 on 2026-07-29: mail_qr_scan_events (Wave B 'Wire the engine', migration 0211). The direct-mail attribution funnel was a capable-looking UI over permanent zeros — qr_scan_count was read in 8 places and written in 0, with no QR generation and no scan endpoint. The rollup column alone cannot answer 'why is this number what it is', and a QR redirect that silently swallows bot/prefetch hits without recording them is just a different kind of unaccountable number, so the scan EVENTS (counted and deliberately-not-counted alike, each with a reason) get a table. Everything else in that migration is additive columns/indexes on existing tables. Deliberate bump per this ratchet's own procedure. PRIOR NOTE — 747 -> 752 on 2026-07-29: abTestOutcomes/marketWatchlist persistence tables (founder ruling #12(c) Wave A — 'Nothing lies': three shipped features ran on in-memory Maps that vanished on every restart). Deliberate bump per this ratchet's own procedure. The five: market_watchlist_entries, market_watchlist_alerts, outreach_ab_tests, outreach_ab_outcomes (T117 + T22), plus investor_verification_requests for the KYC state machine ported in the same wave.
